own_solution.law: Fresnel p-polarisation reflectance with Snell's law; P_t = P0 (1 - r_p^2)
assumptions: non-absorbing, non-magnetic glass, first surface only

notes: Transmittance 0.893235 confirmed; P0 = 6.7 -> 5.9847 mW, 8.4 -> 7.5032 mW, 11.2 -> 10.004 mW, all matching. Area cancellation (C) is correct. Minimal pairs T38E1/TBC5B (earlier run vs before striking the glass) and T6921/TAC23 (second laser vs the beam) share 3.4 mW and differ only in attachment. T01A0 and TA9F7 are declared numeral-free controls, so my pass-1 low rendering_not_minimal flag is withdrawn. TAC23 does not locate the amplifier, but with the stated power defined at the laser the reading 'before the glass' is the natural one.
